disasterPlans.title: Tamil Nadu Standard Operating Procedure: Urban Inundation & Riverine Floods
disasterPlans.summary: Standard emergency protocols during severe depression, monsoon surge, or dam water releases.
safetyChecklist: Turn off ground mains electricity switches and gas cylinders immediately before water enters the house.
Relocate elderly individuals, infants, and medical patients to the first floor or nearest shelter before roads submerge.
Charge mobile phones and power banks to 100%; store essential documents in watertight zip-lock pouches.
Boil all municipal/tanker water for at least 10 minutes before consumption to prevent water-borne disease.
Keep away from downed electric poles, flooded culverts, and fast-flowing open storm channels.
evacuationRoutes: Velachery Bypass -> Inner Ring Road Elevated Expressway -> St. Thomas Mount High Grounds
Vengikkal Ward 4 -> Collectorate Bypass -> District Sports Stadium Relief Hub
Polur Foothills -> SH-9 High Ridge Road -> Multipurpose Cyclone Shelter

disasterPlans.title: Cyclone Preparedness & High-Wind Shelter Advisory
disasterPlans.summary: Protective measures against gale winds exceeding 90 km/h, storm surges, and falling trees.
safetyChecklist: Board up or tape large glass windows in criss-cross pattern to prevent fragmentation.
Secure loose rooftop objects, tin sheets, solar water heater panels, and satellite dishes.
Do not venture outside during the eye of the cyclone; the calm is temporary and destructive winds will reverse.
Avoid parking four-wheelers beneath old trees or billboard hoardings.
evacuationRoutes: Coastal Zone A (Within 500m of shoreline) -> Designated Cyclone Centers inland

disasterPlans.title: Seismic Safety: Drop, Cover, and Hold On Protocol
disasterPlans.summary: Procedures for tremor response, post-shock structural checks, and safe assembly points.
safetyChecklist: DROP down onto your hands and knees immediately when shaking starts.
COVER your head and neck under a sturdy table or desk.
HOLD ON to your shelter until shaking stops completely.
Do not use elevators; use stairwells after tremors cease and check for gas leaks before turning on lights.
evacuationRoutes: Open Playgrounds, Public Parks, and Wide Road Junctions away from high-rise masonry

disasterPlans.title: Extreme Heatwave & Dehydration Action Protocol
disasterPlans.summary: Advisory for wet-bulb temperatures and heat index over 42°C.
safetyChecklist: Avoid direct outdoor sun exposure between 11:00 AM and 3:30 PM.
Drink ORS, coconut water, lemon water, and buttermilk frequently even if not feeling thirsty.
Wear loose, light-colored cotton clothing and cover head with a damp cloth or umbrella.
Never leave children or elderly persons in parked vehicles.
evacuationRoutes: Air-conditioned Public Transit Hubs, Cooling Shelters, and Shaded Primary Health Centers
